title: Procurement Source-to-Pay Microservice

_meta.purpose: Machine-readable PRD for the Procurement Source-to-Pay Microservice (source-to-pay) flat single-concern microservice foundation; metadata-only scope with explicit non-claims.

goals.scalability: Independent horizontal scaling per ADR-0348 (autosharding/auto-rebalance); tenant- and cell-scoped writes with no shared mutable global state. Foundation scope: metadata-only, no measured scaling evidence.
goals.security: Default-deny tenant isolation via Cedar (ADR-0243) and tenant-as-scope (ADR-0244); no raw credential/PII/secret bytes in the domain. Foundation scope: no runtime authentication.
goals.performance: Per-manifest SLO and capacity targets (ADR-0340) required before any GA claim; async-first eventing on Pulsar. Foundation scope: no measured SLO.
goals.efficiency: FinOps cost attribution (ADR-0344) and flat single-concern crates (ADR-0131/0132) that avoid platform bloat. Foundation scope: no runtime cost telemetry.
goals.reliability: Idempotent metadata operations and rollback-first promotion. Foundation scope: no DR drill evidence.

non_goals: No supplier portal or supplier network runtime call.
No durable persistence, Postgres/RLS, Workflow execution, inventory mutation, payment execution, statutory filing, or cloud deployment.
No SAP Ariba, Oracle Procurement, or Coupa exhaustive parity claim.

acceptance_criteria.given: a supplier is onboarded before procurement use
acceptance_criteria.when: the source-to-pay domain qualifies the supplier
acceptance_criteria.then: tenant, legal entity, supplier profile, KYB evidence, risk-screening evidence, approved vendor-master ref, idempotency key, and schema version are present

acceptance_criteria.given: a requester creates a purchase requisition
acceptance_criteria.then: supplier qualification, budget ref, policy evidence, approval evidence, financial amount, requester, approver, tenant, and legal entity are required

acceptance_criteria.given: an approved requisition becomes a purchase order
acceptance_criteria.then: contract ref, approval evidence, issue evidence, amount, supplier, and requisition linkage are preserved without supplier-network or cloud runtime claims

acceptance_criteria.given: goods receipt and supplier invoice arrive for an issued purchase order
acceptance_criteria.then: ordered, received, and invoiced quantities plus ordered/invoiced amounts must match before accounting liability draft is allowed; payment execution, inventory mutation, supplier network calls, and cloud deployment remain false

acceptance_criteria.given: untrusted identifiers, source refs, evidence refs, or money values enter the procurement domain
acceptance_criteria.then: prefix-only, traversal, whitespace/control, credential-shaped evidence refs, nonpositive amounts, and non-ISO currency codes are refused

decision_log.decision: Procurement enters the enterprise microservice set as a flat source-to-pay domain crate rather than a monolithic ERP module; SAP MM/SRM and Ariba-like coverage is mapped through Tenant RBAC parity composition while runtime supplier networks, durable storage, payment rails, Workflow execution, and cloud deployment remain explicit non-claims.
